title: When this part not applicable.
bodyText: Where support or bond has already been pledged or is available, this part shall not be applicable.
bodyHtml: §336-14  When this part not applicable.  Where support or bond has already been pledged or is available, this part shall not be applicable. [L 1957, c 90, §4; Supp, §50A-4; HRS §336-14]
